_about: Perseverance City: who works where. Hand-edited by the owner and by the Team Comeback HQ shipping run (see docs/city/HQ.md). Everything else on the city page (code size, schedule, freshness, bet traces) is generated by tools/orgmap.js. Run `node tools/orgmap.js --check` after any edit.

city.name: Perseverance Holdings
city.motto: Every game played ten thousand times before it tips.
bylaws: Paper money only. Nothing here touches a real account.
The minimum bet is $5 and does not change.
Bets go only to the ten approved books. No desk may edit that list.
A new model replaces an old one only after it passes its test and the chairman approves.
Every check fails loudly. A desk that cannot verify its work says so.

bulletin.text: City opened. Trace a bet is live; Growth and the 3D city come later.
Vacancy: Staff Writer for the 7am Daily Briefing (framework approved, build pending).

companies.name: The Wire
companies.subtitle: Signal Acquisition
companies.about: Gathers the raw facts of the league. Nothing here has an opinion.

companies.name: The Exchange
companies.subtitle: Price Field Observatory
companies.about: Watches what the outside markets think every outcome is worth.

companies.name: The Lab
companies.subtitle: Projection Foundry
companies.about: Turns facts into expectations: matchups, minutes, team strength and how far to trust them.

companies.name: Simulation Floor
companies.subtitle: Many-Worlds Reactor
companies.about: Plays every game in ten thousand parallel worlds and counts how each one ends.

companies.name: Dispatch
companies.subtitle: Chronometry & Operations
companies.about: Keeps time, starts every run, files every document and opens the mail.

companies.name: Our Book
companies.subtitle: Independent Line Forge
companies.about: Posts the lines we would offer, sealed before the market is consulted, then grades them.

companies.name: The Newsroom
companies.subtitle: Signal Synthesis
companies.about: Decides what deserves the chairman's attention and writes the case for and against.

companies.name: Audit & Night School
companies.subtitle: Collapse & Learning Chamber
companies.about: Where every outcome collapses to won or lost, gets explained, and teaches the model.

companies.name: The Trading Desk
companies.subtitle: Execution Core
companies.about: Puts paper money down under the bylaws and keeps the books.

companies.name: The Storefront
companies.subtitle: Interface Deck
companies.about: Where the chairman sees it all: Tonight, Players, Model, Games, and this city.

desks.title: Box Score Clerk
desks.job: Files every completed box score, schedule and shot chart from ESPN.

desks.title: Film Room Analyst
desks.job: Reads play-by-play for true usage and each player's share of the rebounds available.

desks.title: Team Doctor's Liaison
desks.job: Reads the NBA's official injury report as it is posted through the day.

desks.title: Lineup Scout
desks.job: Collects projected and confirmed starting lineups.

desks.title: Referee Desk
desks.job: Learns tonight's referee crews and how they call games.

desks.title: Travel Agent
desks.job: Measures miles flown, time zones crossed, altitude and rest for every team.

desks.title: Signal Inspector
desks.job: Checks that every outside source can be reached from GitHub's servers.

desks.title: DraftKings Runner
desks.job: Collects DraftKings game and prop lines for free, with opening lines and live lines.

desks.title: Second-Market Correspondent
desks.job: Prices the same games and props on Kalshi as a second opinion.

desks.title: Purchasing Agent
desks.job: Buys multi-book odds from The Odds API on a hard credit budget.

desks.title: Fair-Price Accountant
desks.job: Removes the sportsbook's margin to find each side's fair chance, value gaps and arbitrage.

desks.title: Line Historian
desks.job: Records every prop line we price, where each game closed, and how lines moved.

desks.title: Chief of Research
desks.job: Runs the daily research: builds every player dossier the rest of the city reads.

desks.title: Matchup Modeler
desks.job: Projects each player against tonight's opponent: position defense, similar players, history and pace.

desks.title: Schedule Adjuster
desks.job: Corrects each player's numbers for the strength of who he has played. Display only until its test passes.
desks.note: Backtest: better on 5 of 6 stats by 0.1 to 0.5%. Stage 2 waits for about two weeks of live tracking and the chairman's go.

desks.title: Team Rater
desks.job: Rates every team adjusted for opponents and three-point luck; prices spreads and totals.

desks.title: Roster Appraiser
desks.job: Values tonight's actual lineup against the team the ratings were built on.

desks.title: Conviction Officer
desks.job: Scores how much a lean deserves trust, then measures how often leans at that strength actually win.

desks.title: Conviction Understudy
desks.job: A conviction model trained on the bet side. Auditions every night; replaces the Officer only after passing three nights and the chairman's approval.

desks.title: The Engine
desks.job: The game engine itself: possessions, minutes, fouls, blowouts and every stat line.

desks.title: Night Shift Foreman
desks.job: Runs every game on the slate ten thousand times.

desks.title: Live Operator
desks.job: Re-simulates games in progress from the live score and DraftKings' live line.

desks.title: Simulation Grader
desks.job: Scores last night's simulations against what actually happened.

desks.title: Line Setter
desks.job: Seals the lines we would post at 9am, noon, 3pm and 6pm, before looking at the market.

desks.title: Gatekeeper
desks.job: Grades the sealed lines nightly, runs the promotion gates and flags odd book prices.

desks.title: Ranking Editor
desks.job: Picks one side for every priced line and ranks them by conviction, then simulated win rate.

desks.title: Case Builder
desks.job: Writes the case for and against every play, with the record of each kind of reason.

desks.title: Best Bets Picker
desks.job: Chooses tonight's best bets from the ranked board and grades yesterday's.

desks.title: Staff Writer
desks.job: Will write the 7am Daily Briefing and update it through the day. Framework written Nov 16; not yet built.

desks.title: Head Trader
desks.job: Decides what to scan, what to bet and how much, and adapts each playbook to its record.

desks.title: Props Trader
desks.job: Runs the afternoon props session: finds matchup spots, buys odds only where they matter, bets.

desks.title: Bookkeeper
desks.job: Keeps the paper bankroll: places bets, pays out, never lets a number drift.

desks.title: Compliance Officer
desks.job: Holds the bylaws in code: $5 minimum, the ten approved books, paper money, budgets.

desks.title: Messenger
desks.job: Sends a phone alert when a play is worth stopping for.

desks.title: Settlement Clerk
desks.job: Grades every bet from final scores; this is where each outcome collapses to won or lost.

desks.title: Coroner
desks.job: Writes a post-mortem for every settled bet: what happened and why.

desks.title: Sportswriter
desks.job: Tells the story of the game behind each settled bet.

desks.title: Scorekeeper
desks.job: Scores the model against the market's closing prices, stat by stat, every night.

desks.title: Night School Teacher
desks.job: Reads the track record each night and adjusts the model's weights and settings.

desks.title: Building Inspector
desks.job: Runs the checks that fail loudly: freshness, minutes, sims, lines, one side per prop.

desks.title: Test Range
desks.job: Backtests every new idea against past games before it is allowed near a bet.

desks.title: Dispatcher
desks.job: Starts every run (cycle, research, props, injury watch, live, nightly) and catches up missed ones.

desks.title: Clock Tower
desks.job: Twelve schedules a day on GitHub, plus the outside timer that wakes the city every 15 minutes.

desks.title: Archivist
desks.job: Saves and loads every document safely, and keeps time for the whole city.

desks.title: Mailroom
desks.job: Opens the chairman's requests from GitHub issues: bets, refreshes, saved props, switch approvals.

desks.title: City Planner
desks.job: Draws this city from the code itself and keeps the map honest after every run.

desks.title: Front of House
desks.job: The dashboard: Tonight, Players and Model.

desks.title: Games Host
desks.job: One page per game: live score, box score, lines and props.

desks.title: Chairman's Clerk
desks.job: Keeps the chairman's own paper book, sportsbook slips and saved props.

desks.title: Observatory Guide
desks.job: This page: shows the city, traces bets and reports coherence.
